items.title: November 02, 2026
items.summary: Model ArmorFeatureSupport for template-specific exclusion rules in streaming sanitization(StreamSanitizeUserPrompt and StreamSanitizeModelResponse) is available inPreview. You can usedictionary and regular expression exclusion rules in buffered mode(STREAMING_MODE_BUFFERED) with partial or full matching, and in real-time mode(STREAMING_MODE_REALTIME) with partial matching, to mitigate false-positivedetections for prompt injection and jailbreak detection and responsible AIfilters.For more information, see Exclusion rules in streamingsanitization.Oracle Database@Google CloudFeatureOracle Database@Google Cloud supports creating custom DNS domains for your ODB Networks. You can use custom Domain Name Systems (DNS) to control the names of your resources and delegate DNS resolution within your organization. For more information, see Create and manage custom DNS domains.You can use custom DNS domains only for Exadata VM clusters.This feature is generally available (GA).
